attchmntText: Tarmat Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Tarmat Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was Rs 3,856.16 lakhs for the quarter and Rs 6,815.19 lakhs for the half year. Standalone profit before tax stood at Rs 334.22 lakhs for the quarter and Rs 404.82 lakhs for the half year. Basic earnings per share were Rs 1.39 for the quarter and Rs 1.62 for the half year. Consolidated revenue from operations was Rs 3,748.98 lakhs for the quarter and Rs 7,329.88 lakhs for the half year. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report noting an inability to determine the fair value of investments in a joint venture amounting to Rs 783.02 lakhs due to non-availability of financial information. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.

attchmntText: Tarmat Limited has informed the Exchange with copy of minutes of  Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026
